period_note: Cumulative-from-Jan-1 convention (for Q1, cumulative equals the discrete first-quarter figure since there are no prior quarters in the year) established from the filing's own column header 'For the 1st quarter ended on 31 March 2025' / '01 January to 31 March 2025'; flagged via the _cumulative suffix per project convention (matches CITYBANK precedent). Standalone/Solo basis (the filing's plain 'Balance Sheet (Un-audited)' / 'Profit and Loss Account (Un-audited)', distinct from its separately-presented 'Consolidated' statements). Source PDF (1st_quarter_2025.pdf) is a scanned/OCR document whose embedded pdftotext text layer was too sparse/corrupted to trust (only 73 lines extracted, mostly from unrelated notes pages); all figures below were instead sourced via direct visual inspection of 400dpi page renders of the standalone Balance Sheet (source page 7) and Profit and Loss Account (source page 9), both independently verified fully internally consistent (balance sheet ties to the taka: Total Liabilities 334,698,887,137 + Total Equity 25,118,242,664 = Total Assets 359,817,129,801; Profit before tax 917,144,897 - Provision for tax 636,335,070 = Net Profit after tax 280,809,827, matching the filing's own EPS note (0.25) elsewhere in the document). RESTATEMENT FOUND: the FY2026 Q1 report's comparative column for this same period (Jan-Mar 2025), explicitly labeled by the bank as '[previous period's figure restated]' on the deferred-tax line, shows deferred tax income of BDT 977.39mn (vs BDT 216.90mn reported contemporaneously here), producing a much higher restated PAT of BDT 1,041.30mn and EPS of 0.94, versus the BDT 280.81mn / EPS 0.25 reported in this (earlier, contemporaneous) filing. Per project convention, this contemporaneous figure is retained and the later restatement is NOT adopted; the 2026_Q1.json file's period_note also documents this divergence from its own side. CROSS-CHECK DISCREPANCY: this filing's own comparative 'as at 31 December 2024' balance-sheet column shows Total Assets BDT 346,956.97mn and Total Shareholders' Equity BDT 24,700.46mn, which diverge from the existing bank_financials/NCCBANK/quarterly/2024_Q4.json figures (Total Assets BDT 348,206mn, Total Equity BDT 26,871mn; sourced from the FY2025 Annual Report's 'Five Years Performance At a Glance' table) by approximately 0.36% and 8.1% respectively. The identical 31-Dec-2024 comparative figures independently recur in the 2025_Q2 (H1 2025) filing, confirming this is a genuine, reproducible cross-report inconsistency between NCC's own interim filings and its later annual-report summary table -- not a one-off transcription artifact on either side. The existing 2024_Q4.json file was NOT modified.
